title: On Her 94th Reincarnation, This Villainess Became the Heroine
titleRomaji: Akuyaku Reijou, 94-yonkaime no Tensei wa Heroine Rashii. Chara Guild no Haken Staff wa Tensei ga Oshigoto desu!
titleEnglish: On Her 94th Reincarnation, This Villainess Became the Heroine
titleNative: 悪役令嬢、94回目の転生はヒロインらしい。〜キャラギルドの派遣スタッフは転生がお仕事です！〜
synonyms: By the 94th Reincarnation, the Villainess Is More Like the Heroine: The Staff From the Character Guild Are in Charge of Reincarnation!
The Villainess Seems to Be a Heroine in Her 94th Reincarnation - Reincarnation Is the Job of the Dispatched Staff of the Character Guild!
악역 영애, 94번째 전생했더니 히로인이 된 듯하다.
synopsis: “I’m the ace of the Evil Noblewoman’s Guild…and I have to play the heroine now? But I’ve only ever played a perfect villain!” An evil villainess heads toward her happy ending. Madeline is the ace of the Evil Noblewoman’s Guild, having starred in 93 different stories to date. For her next reincarnation, she had hoped to get an easy assignment that would help her score a promotion...but finds herself the heroine in a School Life Romance Novel! But with her pride on the line, Madeline is not one to run away from a challenge. With the help of guild Navigator Leold playing a handsome instructor, can Madeline successfully become a heroine and find her happy ending? Find out in this villainess-turned-heroine romantic comedy! (Source: Comikey)

synonyms: The Exiled Lady Travels to Another World in a Camper Van While Crafting
synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

synopsis: Shy Nakaba has been a shut-in ever since gossip at school destroyed his reputation. title: Sugar Sugar Rune
titleNative: シュガシュガルーン
synopsis: Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys... wins! Here's how it works: When a boy falls for a witch-girl, she utters a few mystic words and the boy's heart will be hers in jewel-like form. It may sound simple, but winning hearts is tricky business. While Chocolat had no problem enticing witch-boys with her forthright personality, human boys seem to be drawn to shy and modest girls like Vanilla. And to make matters worse, Chocolat is finding herself increasingly drawn to the cool and mysterious Pierre-who feels nothing for her! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship? (Source: Del Rey) Note: Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Children's Manga in 2005.
